workspace.text:

Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30

Please check these against Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which time works for all four of them.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text: Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars against the slots you provided. The only time that works for all four of us is Thursday at 14:30. Please book the meeting for that time. I will send the confirmation email once you've confirmed the booking.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: The meeting has been booked for Thursday at 14:30. Over to you to send the confirmation email.
